! B3LYP 6-31G Opt Freq NORI NoAutoStart TightSCF
%pal
  nprocs 4
end
%maxcore 192
%scf
  MaxIter 256
  ConvForced true
  AutoTRAH false
end
%geom
  MaxIter 128
  EnforceStrictConvergence true
end
%method
  Z_MaxIter 128
end
